name: Input Validation & Injection Prevention
description: Validates and sanitizes inputs to agents and tools to prevent injection attacks including prompt injection, command injection, and parameter manipulation. Ensures agent inputs conform to expected schemas and do not contain malicious payloads.
threat_addressed: Prompt injection and input manipulation attacks can cause agents to execute unintended actions, bypass security controls, exfiltrate data, or escalate privileges. Tool parameters containing injection payloads can compromise downstream systems. Without input validation, every agent interaction is an attack vector.
enforcement_mechanism: Validates tool call parameters against expected schemas, scans for injection patterns in agent inputs, and enforces input length and type constraints. Suspicious inputs trigger alerts or blocks based on security mode.

security_outcome.pass: Input validated and conforms to expected schema without injection indicators.
security_outcome.fail: Input validation failed — potential injection or malformed input detected.

display_detail: Validates agent and tool inputs to prevent injection attacks and parameter manipulation.
remediation_hint_template: Potential injection detected in input. Review the input parameters and ensure they conform to expected schemas.
